ratings.comment: Professor Mobley was amazing! Not only are his lectures really interesting, but the specifications grading system meant you could get an A without having to stress yourself out about doing perfect on everything, which really helps with learning. Make sure to go to lecture because there are 'focus questions' at the end which you need for credits

I loved Professor Mobley! Very accessible outside of class and always interested in student feedback. His specification grading system makes it very easy to get an A in the class as long as you show up to class and put in some effort.
Super nice and chill, work's pretty easy with unlimited repeats.

Arguably the best professor I've ever taken. His lectures are straightforward and interesting. The minimal homework and quizzes are extremely easy if you pay attention. You have unlimited retakes on all assignments to obtain credit for the assignment, which is 100%.
Professor Mobley truly cares about each and every student and wants nothing more than them to succeed. Try your best and it'll work out.

I was a little nervous going into this class, since he's the CO of the NROTC, but I absolutely loved this class. He's got a great charisma and teaching style. I'd take any of his classes in a heartbeat.
